scope: The IO ring cell alone, built by the t28-ioring generator from Layout/design/io_ring.json: its layout against its own schematic, with the core-side nets as ports. The ADC core, output register, PCLAMPC macros, pad decoupling, core VSS ring and pad-to-core routes of io_ring.json are not in this cell; chip-level DRC and LVS remain.

baseline.why: A ring the same flow accepted on 2026-05-30 (DRC 0, LVS CORRECT); rerun with this LVS deck on 2026-11-22, again CORRECT. It has four PCORNERA_G and no PCORNER_G, and names its global ESD bus GIOL.

floating.psub.description: psub is not connected to GROUND

name_probe.change: This ring generated again with three nets renamed: VSS to GIOL, AVSS to VSSIB, AVDD to VDDIB (core ports AVSS_CORE/AVDD_CORE follow). The baseline ring uses names of this kind.

floating.nxwell_float.description: nxwell_float is not connected to POWER

floating.psub.description: psub is not connected to GROUND

name_probe.why_names_matter: The T28 deck flags an n-well or n-tap directly on a net whose name is in its exact GROUND_NAME list (floating.nxwell_float, npvss49), and its PATHCHK reads the LVS POWER/GROUND name lists. AVDD is in POWER_NAME and AVSS and VSS are in GROUND_NAME; GIOL, VSSIB and VDDIB are in neither.

disposition.decision: Waived for the ring cell: every result lies inside TSMC library cells, as the designer accepts, and the probe shows that all but the PRCUTA_G results depend only on net names.
disposition.remaining_after_rename: 2 floating n-wells and 4 floating psub where the two PRCUTA_G cells of each power cut abut: unconnected well and substrate islands of the cut cells, the same kind as the baseline's results in its corner, filler and pad cells.

findings: DRC: 2645 checks, 0 results. The cell-level deck deselects 81 checks (2 warnings (DIODMY_L, IO_CONNECT_CORE_NET), 11 other, 61 density (*.DN*), 3 pad opening (AP.*), 4 ESD), so this is not full-chip DRC.
LVS: CORRECT; ports, nets and instances match after transformation (30 / 502 / 1005). The two warnings also appear on the baseline ring.

The deck's VIRTUAL CONNECT NAME "?" joins same-named labels, so the three AVDD_CORE and seven AVSS_CORE core ports compare as one net each; a missing core-side connection only shows in chip-level LVS.

The POC rail carries no label: the generator places none (the baseline ring has none either), and LVS matched it as an unnamed net. The TSMC N28 I/O application note (3.4.2) asks for one label per PVDD2POC on the top-level POC rail.

ERC: 334 results (280 mnpg, 38 floating.nxwell_float, 4 floating.psub, 12 npvss49) against 10 on the baseline, all inside TSMC library cells. The same ring with only VSS, AVSS and AVDD renamed (identical SKILL otherwise, LVS CORRECT) gives 6: 2 floating.nxwell_float, 4 floating.psub, all where the two PRCUTA_G cells of a power cut abut. The other results come from the deck's name lists, not from geometry or connectivity; this corrects the earlier record, which took VSSIB for a ground name. Waived for the ring cell (erc.disposition).

Simultaneous switching: the I/O cells sum to DF 1.547 (8 PRUW08SDGZ at 0.140, SAMPLE's PDDW16SDGZ at 0.427; 2.1 nH, 5 pF, FF -40 C), needing 2 VSSIO and 2 VDDIO cells against 4 and 2. The OA layout holds 1 PDDW16SDGZ_H_G, 3 PRUW08SDGZ_H_G, 5 PRUW08SDGZ_V_G.
The 40 um gaps keep PFILLER20/PFILLER20A fillers, not dummy power cells, by designer decision (io_ring.json decisions.pad_gap_fill).
open_items: Label the POC rail (POC_dig) for chip-level LVS (app note 3.4.2); the generator does not place it.
Chip-level ERC will repeat the name-dependent results inside the IO cells while the nets keep the names AVDD, AVSS and VSS; waive them with this record's name probe as evidence.
Chip-level DRC with the deselected density, pad-opening and ESD checks, and LVS with the ADC assembled in the ring.
